answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 16 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 580 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. What carries the signal here is verification, the prism of cost is what stops the farm, and the island of the record keeps every claim checkable.
